blockers.title: Open questions have no owners or due dates, and one blocks the build
blockers.why: "Which model provider do we use?" decides latency, cost and whether R1's "p95 under 10 minutes" can be met at all, so engineering can't start architecture work while it's open.
blockers.fix: Turn the open-questions list into a table with an owner and a due date for each, and resolve the model provider before eng kickoff (or name the default and the fallback).

blockers.title: No privacy, legal or security review for customer call content
blockers.why: The feature processes recorded external customer conversations, but "Do we store summaries forever?" and "Should external participants receive the summary?" are open, and sending transcripts to a model provider isn't covered; these answers change data storage, retention and sharing behavior.
blockers.fix: Add a dependency on privacy/legal review with an owner and date, and state the v1 retention policy, data-processing terms for the model provider, and who may receive summaries.

improvements: Success metrics: the primary metric is "Recordings with a summary opened within 7 days" but the baseline is "6% opened" (any recording opened); confirm the baseline measures the same thing, or define how summary opens will be tracked.
Success metrics: the guardrail baseline is "n/a, new"; consider adding a second guardrail tied to accuracy or edits (e.g. share of summaries heavily edited) or to call-page performance.
Requirements: R3 "Edits saved and versioned" doesn't say who can see or revert versions; specify permissions (host only? teammates?).
Requirements: cover failure states, e.g. what the user sees if generation fails or exceeds 10 minutes, and whether it retries.
Requirements: state whether calls between 2 and 5 minutes get a partial summary, since R2 only guarantees sections "for calls over 5 minutes".
Rollout: "10 design-partner accounts, then all paid plans" has no percentage ramp; add an intermediate step and an owner for monitoring after launch.
Rollout: account for support docs and sales enablement, since this is a competitive feature sales will want to pitch.
questions: Who owns the model-provider decision, and by when will it be made?
What retention period is acceptable for summaries, and does it match the retention of the underlying recordings?
Should external participants ever receive the summary in v1, or is that explicitly a non-goal?
Do users need consent or notice that call content is processed by an AI/third-party provider?
Which languages must be supported at launch for "summarized in the call's language"?
